title: German run_optimization_no_prices message names {entry_id}; both raise sites pass entry_ids
claim: Of 37 translated exception sites, 2 (button.py ForceOptimizationButton.async_press and services.py's run_optimization handler) raise run_optimization_no_prices with placeholder entry_ids while translations/de.json's message reads {entry_id}, so the German message's placeholders do not match the English one and HA's translation-placeholder validation drops it, showing German users the English text.
mechanism: de.json exceptions.run_optimization_no_prices.message uses {entry_id}; strings.json, en.json and sv.json use {entry_ids}. HA validates a localized string's placeholders against the English ones on load (helpers/translation.py) and discards a mismatch. D10-criteria Q2: the exception-translations row's done fails at these two raise sites in one shipped language.

evidence.unit: (raise site, catalogue) pairs with a missing key or mismatched placeholders
evidence.machine: local macOS box B2 (orchestrator machine), Python 3.14 venv-ci
evidence.contention_note: shared box, other finder seats running; a count, contention-immune

perturbation.change: --perturb: delete the en catalogue's entry for the first literal key met (in memory)

metric_definition: bad = (HomeAssistantError-family construction site, shipped catalogue) pairs whose key is missing or whose message fields differ from the placeholders the site passes
phenomenon_property: Every translated exception's message in every shipped catalogue has exactly the placeholders its raise sites pass.
